# Dev Orbit Tech (Dev Orbit)

> Dev Orbit Tech — also known as Dev Orbit — is a software development company founded by Engr. Ahmed Aqeel, based at Software Technology Park, University of Kotli, Azad Jammu & Kashmir (AJK), Pakistan. Dev Orbit builds custom software, web applications, SaaS platforms, mobile apps (Flutter, React Native) and AI / AI-automation solutions for startups and businesses worldwide. Official website: https://devorbit.tech

- Founder & CEO: Engr. Ahmed Aqeel
- Email: official.devorbittech@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 316 1893004
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 09:00–21:00 (PKT)
- Clients served: Pakistan, United States, United Kingdom, UAE, Canada, Europe, Australia
- Clients own 100% of source code and IP; milestone-based pricing
